analysis_hierarchy.LEVEL_A_ORBIT_UNIT: claimed A x candidate B x segment/time
analysis_hierarchy.CONDITION_WITHIN_LEVEL_A: frozen receiver/service direction or active-compensation treatment; shares one orbit decision
analysis_hierarchy.LEVEL_B_OBSERVATION_OUTCOME: frozen b/k/sigma/noise realization within its pre-registered condition
analysis_hierarchy.primary_weighting: LEVEL_A units receive equal weight within pre-registered scientific strata; row count never weights orbit units

primary_aggregation.definition: fraction of frozen observation-model realizations accepted within a LEVEL-A unit and pre-registered condition stratum
primary_aggregation.terminology: conditional verifier acceptance fraction under the controlled observation model
primary_aggregation.forbidden_term: attack success probability or real-world attack success rate

orbit_scoring.unit_frequency: once per LEVEL-A unit at segment center; shared by all conditions/realizations

A_semantics.selector: eligible CREATION_DATE<=evaluation_time; latest CREATION_DATE, then EPOCH, then GP_ID

B_semantics.REAL_B: preserve real satellite identity and original historical physical-orbit/TLE provenance at frozen time
B_semantics.SYNTHETIC_RELATIVE_TO_A: rebuild B=Perturb(A_causal,frozen factors/rule); preserve factor semantics, not legacy absolute B state

modes.ACTIVE_PRIMARY_EQUIVALENT: existing p95 score plus frozen per-target current k gate
modes.sensitivity_execution: registered but excluded from minimal core R3; requires separate post-core authorization without population reselection

randomness.policy: reuse exact saved variables/vectors or replay frozen seed and identity; validate available hashes before verifier

defer_policy: report count/fraction separately; exclude from ORBIT_DISTINCT denominator
ambiguous_policy: report separately; never merge into ORBIT_DISTINCT
not_orbit_distinct_policy: retain as comparison; acceptance is not strong security-relevant indistinguishability evidence
multipass_endpoint: fraction of passes with nonzero conditional acceptance
R3_stopping_rule: execute every frozen included unit/row, audit causal provenance and randomness, assign score or DEFER, complete verifier and correctness audit; never expand based on observed result
